name: agent-chat
description: A side pane with the conversation between Claude and its subagents: what each was asked, what it did and said, and what it sent back

autoOpen.title: Open when a subagent starts
autoOpen.description: Open the pane the first time Claude starts a subagent in a session (it docks once the window is wide enough); off, open it with /agent-chat

paneColumns.title: Pane width (columns)
paneColumns.description: How wide the pane opens when docked beside the conversation (30 to 120); a width you drag it to wins
